description: The identical program WITH `import { get } from 'scrml:redis'`. Only the import is added — which is exactly the condition the code keys on, and it also proves the redis backend is otherwise admissible against a `sqlite` `db=` (redis is not driver-matched, unlike the SQL backends).
rationale: §39.2.6 — `idempotency-store="redis"` selects a backend whose runtime symbols arrive through the `scrml:redis` import. With no such import anywhere in the module graph the declaration names a store the emitted code cannot reach, and the failure would otherwise surface as a missing runtime symbol on the first non-monotone retry. Module-graph presence is statically decidable, so it is checked.
